# YouTube Video Skills

> YouTube intro/outro and podcast audiogram skills for AI coding agents — brand your channel and turn every episode into video.

![YouTube Video Skills — animated showcase](./showcase.gif)

## Install

```bash
npx skills add iart-ai/youtube-video-skills
```

Or add it as a Claude Code plugin marketplace:

```bash
/plugin marketplace add iart-ai/youtube-video-skills
```

then `/plugin install youtube-video-skills`.

The skills run in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 40+ agents. The full agent runs at **[iart.ai](https://iart.ai/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=youtube-video-skills&utm_content=funnel)**.

## What's included

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [audiogram](./skills/audiogram) | Turn a podcast clip, voiceover, or quote into a captioned waveform video for Reels, TikTok, Shorts, and feed posts. |
| [youtube-intro-outro](./skills/youtube-intro-outro) | Build a 3-5s branded intro sting and a 20s end-screen outro that respects YouTube's clickable element zones. |

## When it activates

- You ask to make an audiogram, turn a podcast into a video, or add a moving waveform to a voiceover.
- You want a square or vertical clip of a podcast quote for social.
- You ask to make a YouTube intro, channel bumper, or logo sting.
- You ask to design an outro, end screen, or end card with subscribe and next-video cards.
- You want a reusable brand template where only the name, logo, colors, and sting change.

## Example prompts

- "Make an audiogram from this 60-second podcast clip with captions, sized for TikTok."
- "Add a reactive waveform and a progress bar to my voiceover and export it 1:1 and 9:16."
- "Make a 3.5s YouTube intro where my logo snaps in on the audio sting."
- "Build an outro plate that leaves room for YouTube's subscribe and next-video elements."
- "Create a reusable intro/outro template I can re-skin per channel from a brand file."
